name: How long do typical home lighting safety upgrade projects take?

mainEntity.name: How long do typical home lighting safety upgrade projects take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of home lighting safety upgrade projects varies significantly based on the scope of work. Minor upgrades, such as installing a few GFCI outlets, might only take a few hours. More extensive projects, like a full home rewire or an electrical panel upgrade, could take several days to a week or more, especially for larger or older homes. The timeline also depends on permit acquisition, inspection schedules, and the availability of materials. Your electrician can provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; minor upgrades take hours, while full rewires or panel upgrades can take several days to over a week, depending on scope and permits.
